_instructions: Setting descriptor catalog for the configuration composer. Each owner keeps a *.settings.json beside its configuration; the composer merges them at runtime. Every leaf of an owner's config must be described or excluded with a reason, and every live file must be an owner or excluded here (webagent_configuration::catalog tests).

excluded_files.docs/*.md: Developer documentation edited in place, not app settings; the composer never offers it.
excluded_files.docs/*/*.json: Developer documentation edited in place, not app settings; the composer never offers it.
excluded_files.docs/*/*.md: Developer documentation edited in place, not app settings; the composer never offers it.
excluded_files.config/browser/browser-pages.json: Which app pages agent browsers may use and whether they may sign in as the person chatting; a security setting changed only by a reviewed source edit.
excluded_files.config/accounts/authentication.json: Trusted proxy addresses decide whose forwarded IP is believed; a security setting changed only by a reviewed source edit.
excluded_files.config/storage/storage-settings.json: Admin database encryption switch; a security setting changed only on the administrator encryption page or by a reviewed source edit.
excluded_files.config/configuration/prompts/*.json: Prompts are never offered by the composer (Q1).
excluded_files.config/configuration/prompts/*.md: Prompts are never offered by the composer (Q1).

excluded_files.config/configuration/prompts/session_nam: Prompts are never offered by the composer (Q1).

excluded_files.config/engine/gates/*.md: Gate prompts (the closing turn's message); prompts are never offered by the composer (Q1).
excluded_files.config/models/providers/*.json: Provider definitions and connections; credentials are never offered (Q1).
excluded_files.src/plugin_packages/diagnostics/diagnost: Diagnostics package configuration; not offered in v1.
